_comment: Budget / contract golden tests. These guard the property the issue asks for: the gateway costs ~1K tokens per session and loads one skill on demand. Thresholds are asserted as max_token_delta against the measured tool-definition cost.

tests._comment: The entire tool surface must stay well under 1K tokens (4 chars/token). A regression that inlines skill descriptions here would blow the budget silently.
A 5-hit search must stay small enough to paste into a turn.
load_skill with sections must return strictly less than the whole file.
Every result carries at least one text content block, so a client never gets an empty payload.
max_results above the schema ceiling is rejected, not silently clamped.
